blocks.text:
●本商品は精密に作られています。無理な力を
加えたり、落としたりすると破損する恐れが
あります。
本商品は精密な電子部品で構成されてい
ます。 落としたり水にぬらしたり、汚したり、
分解したりしないでください。 また、高温・
低温になるところでの使用、保管は避けて
ください。
●プラスチック梱包材は開封後はすぐに捨てて
ください。
●本商品を樹脂製のソファーやシート、タイル
などの上に置かないでください。 長時間接触
していると色が写る場合があります。
●可動部分・取り付け部分を無理な方向に
強く引っ張ったり、曲げたりしないでください。
●発音の一部にイントネーションが違ってい
たり、商品の特性上聞き取りにくい物があり
ますが、ご了承ください。
blocks.translation:
• This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains precision electronic parts. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become very hot or very cold.
• Dispose of plastic packing material immediately after opening.
• Do not place this product on resin (plastic) sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not pull or bend movable parts or attachment parts forcibly in the wrong direction.
• Some voice lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear due to the product’s characteristics.

●本商品の対象年齢は15才以上です。対象年齢未満のお子様には絶対に与えないでください。
●小さな部品がありますので、小さなお子様が誤って飲み込まないように注意してください。
窒息などの危険があります。
●耳の近くで使用してはいけません。 誤って使用すると、聴覚を損なう恐れがあります。
●本商品には電子部品を使用しておりますので、ペースメーカーをご使用の方はご注意ください。
●LEDの光の点滅を見続けないでください。気分が悪くなったりする恐れがあります。
●ベルトを長時間装着していると、汗などでかぶれたりかゆみが生じる場合があります。
皮膚に異常を感じたときは、すみやかにご使用をお止めください。
●回転部に指や髪の毛や衣服などを挟まれないように注意してください。
●スケッチブックに使用しているリングの先端が、尖っていますので指等にケガをしないように
ご注意ください。
≪電池を誤使用すると発熱・破裂・液漏れの恐れがあります。 下記に注意してください≫
●二次電池(充電式電池) は、絶対に使用しないでください。
●古い電池と新しい電池、色々な種類の電池をまぜて使わないでください。
+(プラスマイナス)を正しくセットしてください。
●遊んだ後は必ずスイッチを切り電池を外してください。
電池を入れたままにしておくと、液漏れの恐れがあり危険です。
●ショートさせたり充電、 分解、 加熱、火の中に入れたりしないでください。
●万一、 電池から漏れた液が目に入ったときはすぐに大量の水で洗い、医師に相談してください。
皮膚や服についたときは水で洗ってください。
●廃棄するときは、自治体の廃棄物処理の指示に従ってください。
blocks.translation:
● This product is for Ages 15+. Do not give it to children under the target age.
● Contains small parts; take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them. There is a risk of choking and other hazards.
● Do not use near the ear. Improper use may damage hearing.
● This product contains electronic components—people using pacemakers should exercise caution.
● Do not stare continuously at flashing LED lights. Doing so may cause discomfort or other symptoms.
● Wearing the belt for long periods may cause skin irritation or itching from sweat, etc. If you notice any abnormality in your skin, stop use immediately.
● Be careful not to get fingers, hair, or clothing caught in rotating parts.
● The tips of the sketchbook's binding rings are sharp—be careful not to injure your fingers.
≪Improper battery use may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following≫
● Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
● Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
● Set the + (plus) and − (minus) terminals correctly.
● After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage.
● Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
● If battery fluid gets into your eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a physician. If fluid gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
● When disposing of batteries or the product, follow your local municipality's waste disposal guidelines.

blocks.translation: Inserting Batteries / Turning On the Power

blocks.text:
※電源スイッチがOFFになっていることを確認してください。
※音が小さくなって聞き取りにくくなったり、音が止まるなどの誤動作をする場合や、
LEDの発光が弱くなった場合はすべて新しい電池に交換してください。
①電池ぶたを取り外します。
①-1 キラメイチェンジャー本体背面の電池ぶたの穴を先の細い棒などで押しながら、
①-2 電池ぶたを矢印の方向にスライドさせて取り外します。
②乾電池を入れます。

• Make sure the power switch is OFF.
• If the sound gets quieter and hard to hear, the sound stops or other malfunctions occur, or the LED light becomes weak, replace all batteries with new ones.
• ① Remove the battery cover.
• ①-1 While pressing the hole in the battery cover on the back of the Kiramei Changer with a thin pointed rod or similar, ①-2 slide the battery cover in the direction of the arrow and remove it.
• ② Insert dry batteries.

uncertainties: 小夜 could be a proper name (Sayo) rather than the word for 'night'; translated as 'Night Mode' assuming it refers to a nighttime/quiet mode.
Reading of the given name 充瑠 is assumed as "Mitsuru"; original pronunciation in the source may differ.
Character name 宝路 is assumed as "Houji"; alternate romanizations may exist.
Readings of the names 充瑠, 瀬奈, 為君, and 為朝君 are not certain; English name renderings shown as likely readings.

The single character 「為」 at the start is likely misread or nonstandard here; its intended exclamation is unclear, so "Tame!" is a literal rendering of that character rather than a confirmed natural exclamation (e.g., "All right!" or "Go!").
The term 「邪面獣」 is a franchise-specific creature name; I rendered it as "Jamen Beast" (literal/transliterated).
Reading/meaning of 「為君」 is uncertain in this context; it may be a name (Tame-kun) or mean 'for you'.
Pronunciations of the names 宝路 and 為朝 are uncertain; rendered here as Houji and Tameasa respectively.
ヨドン (Yodon) is left as a transliterated term; its exact meaning depends on the product's fictional terminology.

Romanizations of personal names may be uncertain: 充瑠 (rendered Mitsuru), 為君 (rendered Tame-kun), 為朝 (rendered Tameasa), 宝路 (rendered Houji), 時雨 (Shigure), 瀬奈 (Sena), 小夜 (Sayo), マブシーナ (Mabushina), ター (Taa).
Terms Yodon, Jamen Beast, and Jamen Master are literal renderings of ヨドン, 邪面獣, and 邪面師.

キラッと参上!カラッと解決!魔進戦隊キラメイジャー!
ヨドンヘイムよ、この星はお前たちの好きにはさせん!
blocks.translation:
Sparkling arrival! Quick resolution! Mashin Sentai Kiramei—!
Yodonheim, we won't let you have this planet!

blocks.text: | あの方々は、悪逆非道なあなたに引導を渡す輝きのきらめきに満ちたそのお顔をしかと拝みなさい!
blocks.translation: Behold the faces of those shining warriors who will deliver final judgment to an evil, wicked person like you!

blocks.text: ひらめきスパークリング! キラメイレッド!
導きシューティング! キラメイイエロー!
突撃ライトニング! キラメイグリーン!
切っ先アンストッパブル! キラメイブルー!
手さばきインクレディブル! キラメイピンク!
貫きシャイニング!キラメイシルバー!
キラッと参上! カラッと解決! 魔進戦隊キラメイジャー!
blocks.translation: Sparkling arrival! Quick resolution! Mashin Sentai Kiramei!

blocks.text: これで終わりだ!ヨドン皇帝!
blocks.translation: This is the end! Emperor Yodon!

blocks.text:
為朝さん。誰よりも状況を的確に把握できていて、作戦を立ててくださる
それでいて出しゃばらずに充瑠をリーダーとして立てる奥ゆかしさ!
blocks.translation: Tametomo-san. You grasp the situation more accurately than anyone and lay out the strategy. And yet you never push yourself forward—you modestly uphold Juru as leader!

blocks.text: お兄様。いつでも全力で体を張って私たちを守ってくれました
blocks.translation: Big brother— you always risked your body with everything to protect us.

blocks.text: 笑顔も全開で、みんなにたくさんの勇気をくれたな
blocks.translation: With that full smile, you gave everyone a lot of courage.

blocks.text: 小夜さん。大人でかわいいしなやかなあなたは、
blocks.translation: Sayo-san — as an adult who is cute and graceful,

blocks.text: 決して弱音を吐きません
小夜さんは決して諦めない強い人!
blocks.translation: Sayo-san is strong and never gives up!

blocks.text: 時雨さん。剣の技を追求して戦いに生かすあなたは、 誰よりもストイックでした
blocks.translation: Shigure-san. You pursued sword technique and used it in battle — you were more stoic than anyone.

blocks.text: アニキの自分を律する心。
瀬奈さん。勢いで皆さんを引っ張って、悲しい時も笑顔に変えてくれて
blocks.translation: Sena-san. You pull everyone forward with momentum and turn sad times into smiles.

blocks.text: お嬢様の周りは、いつでも空気が明るうございました!
blocks.translation: The air around you was always bright!

blocks.text: 充瑠さん。あなたは不思議な方でした。おどおどしているけれど弱虫ではなくて
blocks.translation: Juru-san. You were a mysterious person — timid at times, but not a coward.

blocks.text: イメージする力は時にオラディン様以上
blocks.translation: Your power to imagine sometimes exceeds even Lord Oradin's.

blocks.text: はぁ―――!スパークリングフェニックス・デストリアスペシャル!! (チェックメイジパーフェクト!)
blocks.translation: Haa—! Sparkling Phoenix Destria Special! (Checkmate Perfect!)

blocks.text: この6人が、魔進戦隊キラメイジャーです!
blocks.translation: These six are Mashin Sentai Kiramager!

blocks.text: うぉい!またどっかの世界と繋がっちまったんじゃねぇのか?
blocks.translation: Hey! Didn't we connect to some other world again?

blocks.text: さぁ?でもこれも、きっと素敵なものだよ
blocks.translation: Who knows? But I'm sure this will be something wonderful, too.

blocks.translation:
• You're not mistaken! I don't really get it, but you're probably sparkling! You can become a Kirameiger!
• Imagination!? Oh — this is… are you a divine illustrator!?
• Ohhh! This is it! This is your Kiramental!!
• You just haven't given your all yet — you're amazing! Have confidence!
• I've never been complimented like this before… Is there a sparkle inside me?
• Mitsuru! Now's your chance to change too! You can trust the sparkle inside you now, right?
• Change… be able to change… I want to change!
• Go full Kiramental!
• Sayo is a doctor, so the pink stone is a doctor helicopter!
• Machine! Ahaha! "Mashin Helico!" Unforgivable, the height of evil! I'll give you a sharp punishment!
• Shigure seems sharp, so the blue stone is a jet!
• Machine! "Mashin Jetta!" Look at the wings' sparkle! Zooming off—here we go!
• Sena is fast on her feet, so the green stone is definitely a supercar!
• Machine! "Mashin Macha!" In the name of the young lady, I'll finish this with a speedy strike!
• And when you think of a yellow vehicle, it's got to be a shovel car!

blocks.text:
マッシーン!「魔進ショベロー!」 熟練の技とくと見よ!ショベルでほいっと!
死んだと思ったお父さんに会えるかもしれないってなったら、 誰だって信じたくなる!
そんなマブシーナの気持ちを踏みにじってまで、自分の欲望を満たそうとしたお前を、俺は絶対に許さない!
肉体が極限まで疲労した時、人の精神は研ぎ澄まされる。 結果がオールライト!
blocks.translation:
• Machine! "Mashīn Shoberō!" Watch my expert technique! Shovel—heave!
• If you might be able to meet the father you thought was dead, anyone would want to believe it!
• I will never forgive you for trampling on Mabushīna’s feelings just to satisfy your own desires!
• When the body is exhausted to its limit, the mind sharpens. The result is all right!
• A dream... I dreamed about the king again...
• Is this the picture I drew with the king in the dream? Then what just now... wasn't just a dream!
• I want to ask you that! Do you need a reason to help someone?

blocks.text:
夢か･･････また王様の夢見ちゃった......
これ、夢の中で王様と描いた絵? じゃあ今の•••••• ただの夢じゃない!
こっちが聞きたいよ!人を助けるのに、理由がいるの?
早く、早く駆けつけるには••••••う~ん・・・・・・ ひらめキーング!
あのスピードだ!これこれ!機関車よりも速い超特急だ!こいつになってくれ!白の宝石!
でも皆がヘトヘトにしてくれたおかげで光が見えた。王様にも会えた。 この新しい魔進もできたんだ!だから結果がオールライト!
発車オーライ!そして、もうひらめいてたキーング!これが、あの光の巨神だ!
完成! キングエクスプレス!
blocks.translation:
• Was it a dream...? I dreamed about the king again...
• Is this the picture I drew with the king in the dream? Then that means it wasn't just a dream!
• I want to ask that! Do you need a reason to help someone?
• To get there fast, fast... hmm... Hirame-Keeng!
• That speed! That's it! A super express faster than a locomotive! Become this! White Jewel!
• But thanks to everyone wearing themselves out, I could see the light. I got to meet the king. This new Mashin was made too! So the result is all right!
• All aboard! And already inspired, Keeng! This is that giant god of light!
• Complete! King Express!

blocks.text:
でも、やらなきゃいけないからやってるんですよね?で、 人助けは好きでしょ?
俺は、あなたがもっとキラキラしたとこが見たいんです!
限界は、超えないために•••••• そうか、それでいいんだ! ひらめキーング!
待たせてごめんね、みんな!でも俺、ひらめいたから!来い、 キラフルゴーアロー! (キラフルゴーアロー)
限界は超えないことにした。 だから、 その状態でいられるのは100秒だけ。オーケー?
行くよ!(キラフルゴー!) キラフルチェンジ! (まぶしすぎるぜ!)
俺のきらめきは、ひらめきスパークリング!いつも何かを描いてきた。スケッチブックに、頭の中に!
そうスケッチブックだけが友達だった毎日は一変したそれも全部全部ファイヤのせい 「お前は変われる」って言ってくれたから
変わったのはお前の意思だ 俺はただのクリスタリアの石だスケッチブックで俺らを変えた 何度でも言う お前スゲー奴だ!
ありがとう俺と出会ってくれて 何があっても切れない絆 絶交なんてしない絶対 俺たち全員でキラメイジャー!
お前は敵だけど、お前のその姿や必殺技、俺に言わせれば神絵師だ!めちゃくちゃワクワクしちゃうんだ!
だから本当は、本当は一緒に絵が描きたい!
「俺が生きた意味は今ここで生み出す」ってガルザの言葉、俺に思いをつなげるってことだったんだと思う
助けてもらった俺がしっかり生きることで、ガルザが生きた意味になるんだ
充瑠が戻って、こっちは力も夢も勇気もでっかくなってんだ!作ってやろうぜ、 新しい歴史!
うん!これが本当に最後の決戦だ! みんな、いこう!
うおー!これ懐かしい!みんなが本気で戦っているのを、 空気読まずに描きまくってたんだよね~
でもそのお陰でキラメイジャーになれたんだから、 結果がオールライト!
何かに夢中になるって最高だよね!
人が輝く時、そこに奇跡が生まれる。 輝き、 それは未来を変える戦士の証。 キラメイGO!!
blocks.translation:
• But you're doing it because you have to, right? And you like helping people, don't you?
• I want to see you shine even more!
• Don't exceed your limit… I see, that's fine! Inspiration—Keying!
• Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! But I had a flash of inspiration! Come on, Kirafull Go Arrow! (Kirafull Go Arrow)
• I've decided not to exceed my limit. So I can only stay in that state for 100 seconds. Okay?
• Here we go! (Kirafull Go!) Kirafull Change! (It's too dazzling!)
• My sparkle is Inspiration Sparkling! I've always been drawing something—on my sketchbook and in my head!
• Yeah, the days when only my sketchbook was my friend changed completely, and it was all because of Fire saying, 'You can change.'
• What changed was your will. I'm just a Crystaria stone. The sketchbook changed us. I'll say it again and again: you're an amazing person!
• Thank you for meeting me. We have a bond that will never break no matter what. We'll never sever ties—absolutely. All of us together are Kirameiger!
• You're an enemy, but your appearance and your finishing moves—if I had to say it, you're a divine artist! It gets me really excited!
• So, honestly, I really want to draw together with you!
• I think Garza's words 'The meaning of my life will be born here and now' meant connecting his feelings to me.
• By living firmly—the one who was helped—Garza's life will have meaning.
• Chulu has returned, and here our strength, dreams, and courage have grown big! Let's make a new history!
• Yes! This really is the final battle! Everyone, let's go!
• Whoa! This brings back memories! I used to draw nonstop without reading the room while everyone was fighting seriously~
• But thanks to that I became a Kirameiger, so the outcome is all right!
• Being absorbed in something is the best!
• When people shine, miracles are born there. That shine is the proof of a warrior who changes the future. Kiramei GO!!

blocks.translation:
• Kiramei Green!
• Kiramei Change!
• Charge Lightning! Kiramei Green!
• Nice to meet you, milady. Please forgive this sudden visit.
• Wow, a cool voice...wait, what is this? A talking jewel?
• I don't really get it, but go for it!
• Swift as the wind, milady — truly wonderful! It's perfect!
• But I heard the Kirameijar must become one as five people. It seems only the five of us can protect Earth.
• Are those your own words? You're just repeating what someone told you, right? I won't accept someone like that as leader.
• Got it—I'll try it on you!
• Yay! Another bright, sunny day in Japan!
• We're the Kirameijar, so each of us has to shine. That's what the five of us are for.
• Thanks for making me sparkle, Leader.
• Was it this way, milady? How about a little drive?
• What a thing! Milady's 'Kiramental' is dramatically heating up!
• I'll race ahead just being myself!
• Charge Lightning! Kiramei Green!
• Flash Sparkling! Kiramei Red!
• Guiding Shooting! Kiramei Yellow!
• Tip Unstoppable! Kiramei Blue!
• Hand Movements Incredible! Kiramei Pink!
• We are Mashin Sentai Kirameijar—appearing with a sparkle, solving it with a sunny finish.
• We'll sprint all at once!
• Houro, you decided to fight with us, right? If you can't give your all,
• that's a Kirameijar problem! So in the end it's my problem. I see. I like you.
• I guess I was overthinking. I finally understand that 'nikiniki' is important. From now on, I'm all about nikiniki!
• Come to think of it, when I decided to keep doing track as a working adult, I planned that if it failed I'd work at a hamburger place on the Shonan coast.
• Yodonna will appear again — don't just wait, want to go on patrol? I can't stand staying still!
• This situation looks great on camera! Everyone, take pictures! Come, come!
• Could you be a little quiet? I'm analyzing how I can fight now that there are five of me. Now that there are ten Kirameijar, we're invincible.
• We can take down Yodonheim in one go! I'm so happy I could cry~
• Even though we've increased to five people, our power might be one-fifth... and only one Kiramei Changer was left.
• I thought it was strange that the fake one was the one who transformed and fought, but
• Thanks to that I'm super hyped and really grateful to Juru!
• Being able to make decisions unconstrained by convention is also a sign of a good leader!

宝路さん、私たちと一緒に戦うって決めたんでしょ?だったらあんたが全力を出せないのは、
キラメイジャーの問題ってことなの!だから、結局は私の問題なの
source_blocks.translation: Hōro-san, you decided to fight alongside us, right? If that's the case, the fact you can't give it your all is a problem for the Kiramager team! So, ultimately, it's my problem.

source_blocks.text: そういうことか。お前、気に入ったぜ
source_blocks.translation: So that's how it is. I like you.

source_blocks.text:
考えすぎてたみたい。やっとわかったの、ニキニキが大事だって。これからは私、ニキニキだ一つ!
そういや、社会人で陸上続けることにした時は、 ダメなら湘南の海沿いのハンバーグ屋さんで働くって決めてたな
ヨドンナはまた現れるよ、待ってないでパトロール行かない?私、じっとしてるの我慢できない!
source_blocks.translation:
I must've been overthinking. I finally got it — Niki-Niki is what matters. From now on, I'm all about Niki-Niki!
Come to think of it, when I decided to keep doing track after becoming a working adult, I had a backup plan: if it didn't work out, I'd work at a hamburger shop by the Shonan coast.
Yodonna will show up again. Instead of waiting around, why don't we go on patrol? I can't stand being still!

source_blocks.text: この状況、映えるよね!みんな撮るよ!来て、来て
source_blocks.translation: This situation will look great in photos! I'm taking pictures of everyone — come over, come over!

source_blocks.text: ちょっと静かにしてもらえますか?5人になった私がどう戦えるのか分析中なので
source_blocks.translation: Could you be a little quieter? I'm analyzing how I — now that I've become five — can fight.

source_blocks.text: これでキラメイジャー10人になったから無敵だね。
source_blocks.translation: Now that there are ten Kiramagers, we're invincible.

source_blocks.text: ヨドンヘイムなんか一気にやっつけられる!なんか、もう嬉しくて泣けてきた〜
source_blocks.translation: We can take out Yodonheim in one sweep! I'm so happy I could cry~

source_blocks.text: 5人に増えたって、力は5分の1になってるかもしれないし･･････それにキラメイチェンジャーも1つしか残らなかった
source_blocks.translation: Even if we've increased to five, our power might be split into fifths... Besides, only one Kiramai Changer was left.

source_blocks.text: 変身して戦うのが偽物のほうなんてアリ!? って思ったけど、
source_blocks.translation: I thought, "Is it okay for the fake one to be the one that transforms and fights?" but...

source_blocks.text: お陰であたしはめちゃくちゃテンション上がって充瑠に大感謝!
source_blocks.translation: Thanks to that, I got super hyped — huge thanks to Juru!

source_blocks.text: 常識に囚われない決断が出来るのもいいリーダーの証だよね!
source_blocks.translation: Being able to make decisions without being bound by common sense is also proof of a good leader, right!

source_blocks.text: 弱音を吐けないのはアニキの弱さなのかもしれない。けど、そんなアニキが僕は好きなんだ
source_blocks.translation: Not being able to show weakness might be Aniki's flaw. But that's the Aniki I like.

source_blocks.text: だから、アニキにかっこつけさせてくれよ!
ひらめキーング! 時雨にはとことん、かっこつけてもらう!
source_blocks.translation: Eureka! I'm going to have Shigure go all-out and look cool!

source_blocks.text: 我らがあの宝を取り戻すまで、殿はお待ちくだされ!我慢して、ギリギリまで配下に託して、
source_blocks.translation: My lord, please wait until we retrieve that treasure! Endure and entrust the task to your followers until the very last moment.

source_blocks.text: ためにためて一瞬で決める! それが、時雨のかっこよさ、だろ?
source_blocks.translation: Build up the tension, then decide in an instant! That's Shigure's coolness, right?

source_blocks.text: わかった。ならば命じる、死ぬなよ
source_blocks.translation: Understood. Then I order you: don't die.

source_blocks.text:

もしそれができたら、逆にもっと強くなれるような気がする。変だよね
source_blocks.translation: If it's in front of them, I feel like I could reveal the weaknesses I've never shown anyone. If I could do that, I feel like I'd actually become stronger. It's strange, isn't it?

source_blocks.text: ファンだと言ってくれる人のことを、俺は嫌いにはなれない。だが、今の俺には芝居しかないんだ、ごめん
source_blocks.translation: I can't bring myself to dislike people who call themselves my fans. But right now, acting is all I have — I'm sorry.

source_blocks.text: がっくしだよ!全部アニキのせいじゃん!
source_blocks.translation: What a letdown! It's all your fault, Aniki!

source_blocks.text: 距離を埋めたいのなら、相手の気持ちに寄り添ってみるといい。 そうだな、 例えば・・・・・・
source_blocks.translation: If you want to bridge the gap between you, try empathizing with how the other person feels. Let's see... for example...

source_blocks.text: ああ、いや、君のアドバイスはいらん!細かいことを気にしすぎる軟弱男にはなりたくないからな!
source_blocks.translation: Oh, no—I don't need your advice! I won't become some weakling who worries about every little thing!

source_blocks.text: うっわ!軟弱男って、ひどくない、ですか?
source_blocks.translation: Wow! Calling someone a "wimp"—isn't that a bit harsh?

source_blocks.text: 今度出演する、新作釣り映画の決めゼリフをお聞かせしよう。 釣られたら釣り返す。 今、俺の右手は神になる!
source_blocks.translation: Let me give you the catchphrase from the new fishing movie I'm in: "If I'm hooked, I'll hook you back. Now, my right hand becomes a god!"

source_blocks.text: こんな時、心を癒やして活力を与えてくれるのはエンタメだ!エンターテインメントだ!俺が行く!
source_blocks.translation: At times like this, it's entertainment that heals the heart and gives energy! Entertainment! I'm going!

source_blocks.text: 千人力じゃない、万力だ! 何言わすんじゃコラァ!
source_blocks.translation: Not the strength of a thousand — the strength of ten thousand! Don't make me say things like that, hey!

source_blocks.text: 俳優として忠告だ! 物語性も無くただ人を苦しめる映画など・・・笑止千万!
source_blocks.translation: Advice as an actor: a film that has no story and only torments people... preposterous!

source_blocks.text: 任せろ。役者にはすべての食事シーンを1日でまとめて取ることがある
source_blocks.translation: Leave it to me. Sometimes actors film all of their eating scenes in a single day.

source_blocks.text: あれと同じだと思えば･･････イケる! カルビでも万力でも持ってこーい!
source_blocks.translation: If I think of it as the same thing... I can do it! Bring on the kalbi—or even a vise!

source_blocks.text: キラフルゴーアローか･･････ふふ、思い出すな、あの言葉
source_blocks.translation: The Kirafull Go-Arrow... heh, that phrase brings back memories.

source_blocks.text: 「限界は超えないためにある」 ･･････ いかにも充瑠らしい言葉だ
source_blocks.translation: "Limits exist so we don't exceed them"... That's so like Juru.

source_blocks.text: 新時代のリーダーらしくてカッコいい･･････だから、 そう…………..
source_blocks.translation: He's cool—like a leader of a new era... So, yeah...

source_blocks.text: ほんとは俺が言いたかった~、もお!
source_blocks.translation: I really wanted to say that! Geez!

俳優として忠告だ! 物語性も無くただ人を苦しめる映画など・・・笑止千万!
任せろ。役者にはすべての食事シーンを1日でまとめて取ることがある
あれと同じだと思えば･･････イケる! カルビでも万力でも持ってこーい!
キラフルゴーアローか･･････ふふ、思い出すな、あの言葉
「限界は超えないためにある」 ･･････ いかにも充瑠らしい言葉だ
新時代のリーダーらしくてカッコいい･･････だから、 そう…………..
ほんとは俺が言いたかった~、もお!

手さばきインクレディブル! キラメイピンク!
あら、素敵な宝石ね。エモいかも
blocks.translation: Oh, what a lovely gem. It might be kind of emo.

blocks.text:
見る目もばっちりで好き好き、あは
お仕置きが必要ね、あなたたち
小夜さんったらきまりすぎ~、好き好き
地球でもキラメイストーンが見つかるなんて･･････ ・なんたるちあ、サンタルチア
blocks.translation:
• You have great taste—I love it, aha. You two need to be punished.
• Sayo is way too prim—I love her, love her.
• To think Kiramei Stones were found on Earth... what a thing, Santa Lucia!

blocks.text: 無理?絶体絶命? この患者は私が必ず助けます!
blocks.translation:
• Impossible?
• Doomed?
• I will definitely save this patient!

blocks.text: 小夜さんに不可能は、ありませんえん百万円!
blocks.translation:
• Nothing is impossible for Sayo!
• One million yen!

blocks.text: 大人じゃないもん! 小夜、五歳だもん!
blocks.translation:
• I'm not an adult!
• Sayo, I'm five years old!

blocks.text: ････無理じゃない。 絶体絶命なんかじゃない!
blocks.translation: It's not impossible. This isn't a hopeless, life-or-death situation!

blocks.text: みんなは小夜が守るって決めた! (キラメイGO!キ・ラ・メーイ!)
blocks.translation: Everyone decided that Sayo will protect us! (Kiramei GO! Ki-ra-mei!)

blocks.text: キラメイチェンジ!小夜が必ず助ける!(キラメこうぜ!)
blocks.translation:
• Kiramei Change! Sayo will definitely save you!
• (Let's Kirame!)

blocks.text: てばさき~インゲン豆! キラメ~イピンク!
あっ!ひらめクイーン!さっきの時雨くんの技を応用しよ?
blocks.translation: Ah! Hirame Queen! Shall we adapt Shigure-kun's technique from earlier?

blocks.text: なんでも?それじゃあママリナフニフニでもオーケーか?
blocks.translation: Anything? Then is "Mamarina Funifuni" okay too?

blocks.text: ああ、するする!ママリナフニフニでもパパレホドリミンパでもなんでもするから!
blocks.translation: Yes, I'll do it, I'll do it! I'll do anything—whether it's “Mama Rina Funifuni” or “Papa Reho Doriminpa”!

blocks.text: でも、人ひとり背負ってるのに全然平気そうだね。 愉快痛快怪力くんなの?
blocks.translation:
• But you’re carrying someone on your back and you look totally fine.
• Are you "Yukai Toukai Kairiki-kun"?

blocks.text: ダメ、全然ダメ!瀬奈ちゃん、テンポが走りすぎ!時雨くんはカッコつけすぎて演奏が雑!
blocks.translation: No — totally no good! Sena, your tempo is way too rushed! Shigure, you're trying too hard to look cool and your playing is sloppy!

blocks.text: 充瑠くんはチューニングがずれてる!タメくんは気持ちがこもってない!
blocks.translation: Mitsuru-kun's tuning is off! Tame-kun isn't putting any feeling into it!

blocks.text: ねぇ、私が書いた歌詞、 渡したよね?ちゃんと理解して!
blocks.translation:
• Hey — you gave out the lyrics I wrote, right?
• Make sure you understand them properly!

blocks.text: うん、今の感じエモかった!これならきっと、 幸也くんも喜んでくれると思う
blocks.translation: Yeah, that felt emotional! I'm sure this will make Koya-kun happy, too.

blocks.text: もしその気になって結婚しても、 キラメイジャーやってちゃ結婚生活、 楽しめなくない?
blocks.translation: Even if you decide to get married, if you're still a Kiramager, wouldn't married life be less enjoyable?

blocks.text:
もしくは「物足りないカツオのタタキ」って思うのは、確かだろうな〜。 じゃあ行ってきま~す
私は、もしあなたと気が合って結婚したとしたら、外科医とキラメイジャーで大変で、
平穏な結婚生活にはならないだろうなと思った!
blocks.translation:
• Or thinking "it's an underwhelming seared bonito" is probably true. Well then, I'm off~
• I thought that if I got along with you and we married, life would be hard with a surgeon and a Kiramager, and it wouldn't be a peaceful married life!

blocks.text: でも、好きで選んだならしょうがない、 楽しくなるように頑張ろうって思ってたよ
blocks.translation: But if I chose it because I liked it, it can't be helped—I thought I'd try to make it fun.

blocks.text: 電光石火の魔進エクスプレス! これ見ると思い出すなあ
blocks.translation:
• The lightning-fast Mashin Express!
• Seeing this really brings back memories.

blocks.text:
充瑠くんが私たちの無茶なトレーニングで珍しく逆ギレしたこと
でもあのキレ方がまた充瑠くんらしくてエモ可愛かったのよねえ・ ・ふふつ
blocks.translation: Mitsuru-kun unexpectedly snapped at us during our reckless training. But the way he snapped was so him—kind of emo-cute, wasn't it... hehe.

blocks.translation: Hmm, in that case... I guess it would have to be this: a public restroom consisting entirely of private stalls.

blocks.translation:
• I don't have the kind of power my father had. There's no way I could fight the Yodon Army…
• Don't worry so much — dumpling soup! Our foundation made the Kiramei Changer,
• With this, you can give the stones you brought to a warrior and grant them power.
• I feel sorry for that heroine… I understand how she feels… waaah… Oh—so much came out!
• Goku-zai

じゃあ風邪引くなよ、お風呂入れよ、頭洗えよ、宿題しろよ。また来週!

• A man who demonstrates supremely wondrous power and skill for the peace of Earth.
• His name is Kurisutaria Horo — I'm off to Wonder!
• Don't catch a cold. Take a bath. Wash your hair. Do your homework. See you next week!

遅咲きクリエイティブ! キラメイゴールド!
お! そ、それは!まさか、やめろマブシーナ!それは、メロロフモフモだぞ!あっ、マブシーナ!おい!
blocks.translation:
• Oh! Th-that is—!
• No way—stop, Mabushīna!
• That's Merorofumofumo!
• Ah, Mabushīna!
• Hey!

source_blocks.text: 充瑠は「一人じゃないって ~素敵なこと~ね~」と教えてくれた
source_blocks.translation: Juru taught me that "not being alone" is a wonderful thing.

source_blocks.text: たぶんちょっとヤな奴だった俺にも笑顔をくれてワンダーサンキュー!
source_blocks.translation: You gave a smile even to someone like me, who was probably a bit of a jerk—wonder, thank you!

source_blocks.text: いやいやいやいいねいいね、このほのぼの感。

source_blocks.translation: Please shine even more and more!

もうちょい寝とりたかったがぁ･･････
source_blocks.translation: I wanted to sleep a little longer, though...

早くお会いしたいですね、 素敵なご主人様に

source_blocks.text:
この僕にふさわしい相棒か、探すの苦労しそうだぜ
カワイイ人かなぁ、ドキドキでキュンキュン~、あは
source_blocks.translation:
Finding a partner worthy of someone like me... that sounds like a challenge.
I wonder if they'll be cute? My heart's already racing and fluttering—aha!

source_blocks.text:
相方が輝く時、石も輝く。 今日は、相方大好き魔進が熱く語ります キラメイGO!
僕の相方は押切時雨アニキ。アニキのスゴイとこは、シャキーン、かっこよすぎるとこ!
小夜さんはねぇ、すっごいお医者さんで、すっごい優しくって、う~ん、すっごいかわいい!
為朝の作戦は絶品じゃからな、 その上射撃は百発百中!どうじゃ、スゴイじゃろ。
source_blocks.translation:
When a partner shines, the Stone shines too. Today, we Mashin who love our partners will speak passionately! Kiramei GO!
My partner is Oshikiri Shigure, my big bro. What's amazing about him is—shing—how unbelievably cool he is!
Sayo-san is an incredible doctor, so kind, and... hmm, so very cute!
Tametomo's tactics are exquisite, and his shooting is always dead-on—what do you think? Pretty amazing, right?

source_blocks.text: さすがNo.1 eスポーツプレイヤーじゃ
source_blocks.translation: As expected of the No.1 e-sports player.

source_blocks.text:
はぁ・・・・・・あなたの笑顔に、私はどれ程勇気づけられてきたことか。
瀬奈お嬢様は、私の太陽です!あぁ、なんというまぶしさ、なんという神々しさ!ああ、ゴッド!
じゃあ次は充瑠の番でいいな。 「熱田充瑠のここがスゴイ!」
まず俺の相棒、充瑠はな、充瑠はカワイイ! すっごくカワイイ!
source_blocks.translation:
*Sigh*... Your smile has given me so much courage.
Lady Sena, you are my sun! Oh, such radiance—such divinity! Oh, God!
Alright, then it's Juru's turn. "What makes Atsuta Juru amazing!"
First off, my partner Juru—well, Juru is cute! He's super cute!

source_blocks.text:
充瑠はかわいい顔で、ちょっとばかり情けなく見えるが･･････ 実は熱いハートを持ってるんだ。
相方が輝く時、石も輝く。今日も俺たち魔進が思う存分熱く語るぜ! キラメイGO!
source_blocks.translation:
Juru might look a bit pathetic with that cute face of his... but deep down, he's got a burning heart.
When a partner shines, the stone shines too. Today, we Mashin are going to talk with all the passion we've got! Kiramei GO!

source_blocks.text: 焦らず、呼吸を整えれば必ず斬れる
source_blocks.translation: Don't rush; steady your breathing, and you will surely land the strike.

source_blocks.text: 石の呼吸 ･･････ う~ん･･････ジェット斬り!
source_blocks.translation: Breath of Stone... Hmm... Jet Slash!

source_blocks.text: ほほほっ、若い体は身軽でええのう!ほいっ、ほいほい!
source_blocks.translation: Ho ho ho! A young body is so light and agile—it's wonderful! Up you go—hop, hop!

source_blocks.text: よっ! ショベル界のスーパースター!
source_blocks.translation: Hey there! The superstar of the excavator world!

source_blocks.text: 落ち着いて、飛ばなくても得意の回転技は使えるわ。 ヘリコはできる子、強い子よ
source_blocks.translation: Calm down—you can still use your signature spinning moves even without flying. Heliko, you're capable and strong.

source_blocks.text: そうでした、私は強い子!キャ~、パチパチ!ビシッとお仕置きできました!
source_blocks.translation: That's right—I'm a strong girl! Yay! *Clap, clap!* I really showed them who's boss with that punishment!

source_blocks.text: 私、マッハのこと大好きだよ! 私と同じように、思いっきり突っ走るマッハが大好き!
source_blocks.translation: I love you, Mach! I love how you go full speed ahead, just like me!

source_blocks.text: はっ、 大好き!? 瀬奈お嬢様と同じように突っ走ります!攻撃は最大の防御。 アクセル全開でいきますよ
source_blocks.translation: Huh? You love me?! I'll charge ahead just like Lady Sena! Offense is the best defense—I'm going full throttle!

source_blocks.text: よし、じゃあ、あれいこうぜ!
ひらめきスパークリング!キラメイファイヤ!ヘヘッ!

魔進ファイヤ
押切時雨
ファイヤ最高! みんなも最高!
source_blocks.translation: Faiya is awesome! Everyone's awesome too!

source_blocks.text: テンションMAX!めっちゃメラメラだよ!
source_blocks.translation: Tension MAX! I'm totally fired up!

source_blocks.text: 熟練じゃあないけど、俺の技とくと見よ! ショベルで、ほいっと!
source_blocks.translation: I'm not a seasoned pro, but watch my technique! With the shovel—heave-ho!

source_blocks.text: マッハの名にかけて、速攻で終わらせる!
source_blocks.translation: In the name of Mach, I'll finish this in a flash!

source_blocks.text: 見ろ、翼のきらめき!ギュイーンといくぞ!
source_blocks.translation: Look at the sparkle of the wings! Here I go—whoosh!

uncertainties: Romanization of the trademarked names (especially マッハ, ショベロー) may differ from official English product names.
These are isolated numeric labels (5, 6, 7, 00, 8, 9) with no surrounding context; their purpose (e.g., button labels, step numbers, or display values) is unknown.
The scanned '00' is read literally as two zeros; confirm whether it represents '00' rather than '0' or another symbol in the original.
Reading of 魔進 is not certain from the image; rendered here as 'Mashin' as a proper name.
The katakana ファイヤ is transliterated here as “Faiya”; it could alternatively be intended as the English word “Fire.”
Reading of 魔進 is assumed to be 'Mashin' and of ヘリコ is assumed to be 'Helico'; the source provides no official English rendering.
Uncertain romanization/translation of the proper name 'ショベロー'; rendered as 'Shoberō' (Mashin = 魔進). If a different official English name exists, this may not match.
Rendered the proper name 魔進マッハ as 'Mashin Mach' (マッハ interpreted as 'Mach').
Reading of 魔進 as 'Mashin' is inferred from common usage in product names; other readings (e.g., 'Majin') are possible.
Reading of ヘリコ rendered as Helico; could also be "Heriko" depending on product romanization.
Reading of ファイヤ rendered as Fire; could be romanized as "Faiya".
Interpretation of '5' in 魔進5体 treated as the number five (Five Mashin units).
The katakana ファイヤ could be a character name "Faiya" or the English word "Fire"; the source doesn't make the intended reading explicit.

blocks.text:
許すまじ、悪の極み。ビシッとお仕置きよ!うふふ!
お前ら、最高だ! キラメンタル全開でいくぜ!
COOめキーングしてみました!
| サメにはサーチ能力があるから、それをイメージしてみたよ。 あいつの急所を探して!ロレンチーニサーチ!
そして博多南さんのおかげで復活した、このアクアキラメイストーン
名付けて、魔進ザビューン!
マッシーン!オラーッ!
おう!俺様は何ができるんだ?
シャーッ!
blocks.translation:
• Unforgivable — pure evil. I'll give you a sharp punishment! Hehe!
• You guys are awesome! I'll go full Kiramental!
• I tried COO-me keying!
• And thanks to Hakataminami's help, this Aqua Kiramei Stone was revived.
• I named it Mashin Zabyuun!
• Machine! Oraa!
• Oh! What can I do?
• Sharks have a search ability, so I pictured that. Find its weak point! Lorenzini Search!
• Shaa!

blocks.text:
俺様の速さを刮目して見ろ!
ザザザザザビューン!
我が輩の喜怒哀楽を引き出せぬなら、お主たちは一生我が輩の下で潰されることになる
悲しみの銀河で溺れるお前を、俺が救ってやれたなら。ハコブーを救えないのは俺の力不足だ!
こんなに頑張ったのに、うーん悔しい、悔しいよ〜!うう〜
おっ、おい、そんなに泣くな。 そんな悲しそうに泣かれたら、 我が輩は、 我が輩は・・・・・・びえーん
いやぁ、久々に思いっ切り泣いたら、心が軽くなった。 自分でも驚き桃の木石磨きなんつってな!いや~はっはっは
いやはや、泣きじゃくるお主と幼い頃の王が重なってな。
あの頃のオラディン様は聡明ではあったが、いかんせん幼くあられた故
マッシーン!
我が輩は、オラディン王をお育てしたストーンにして、オラディン王に魔進にしていただいた、
blocks.translation:
• Watch closely and witness my speed!
• Zazazazaza—byuun!
• If you cannot draw out my emotions, you will spend your life crushed beneath me.
• If I could save you who drown in the sorrowful galaxy—failing to save Hakoboo is my own lack of power!
• I tried so hard—ugh, I'm frustrated, I'm so frustrated! Uuu—
• Hey, hey, don't cry so much. If you cry that sadly, I— I— boohoo
• Man, after crying my heart out for the first time in ages, I feel lighter. Even I was surprised—what a turnaround! Ha ha ha Seeing you sobbing reminds me of the king when he was a child.
• Back then Lord Oradin was intelligent, but regrettably he was still very young.
• Machine!
• I am the Stone who raised King Oradin, and whom King Oradin made into a Mashin,

blocks.text:
クリスタリアーの剛の者ハコブーなり!ブーーーー!
久しぶりだな、みんな。 見よ!私は本当の不死鳥になったぞ
ハコブー、お前も来い!
blocks.translation:
• I am Hakoboo, the mighty one of Crystalia! Buuuuu!
• Long time no see, everyone. Look! I have become a true phoenix.
• Hakoboo, you come too!

blocks.text: 相変わらず画奮使いが荒いですなはっはっはっはっ!
blocks.translation: You're still as rough as ever with your artists—hahahaha!

blocks.text:
魔進合体!
レッツ魔進合体!
よーし、私も戦っちゃうぞ!
blocks.translation:
• Mashin combine!
• Let's Mashin combine!
• Alright, I'll fight too!

blocks.text:
完成、グレイトフルフェニックス!
OK牧場、充瑠くん!懲りないガルザにはこってりコテコテのお仕置きだ!
ブー!先日はガルザに拘束されるという我が輩の失態をお許しくださり、まことに恐縮です!
王は本当に幼い頃から、お優しく・・・・・
お前は話が長い!
blocks.translation:
• Complete: Grateful Phoenix!
• OK Ranch, Mitsuru! Give that incorrigible Garza a real, thorough punishment!
• Boo! I am truly grateful that you forgave me for my blunder of being captured by Garza the other day!
• The king has really been kind since he was a child…
• You talk too much!

blocks.text:
呼ばれて飛び出てザザザビューン!
呼ばれてないが俺様も行く!
blocks.translation:
• They called me and I shot out—za-za-za byuun!
• I wasn't called, but I'm going too!

I won't forgive the ultimate evil. Time for a sharp punishment! Hehe!
You guys are the best! Let's go full-throttle with our Kiramental!

source_blocks.text: そして博多南さんのおかげで復活した、このアクアキラメイストーン
source_blocks.translation: And this Aqua Kiramei Stone, restored thanks to Hakata-minami-san.

source_blocks.text: 名付けて、魔進ザビューン!
おう!俺様は何ができるんだ?

COOめキーングしてみました!
| サメにはサーチ能力があるから、それをイメージしてみたよ。 あいつの急所を探して!ロレンチーニサーチ!
source_blocks.translation:
I tried making a "COO-meking" version!
| Sharks have a special ability to sense their surroundings, so I tried to capture that vibe. Find that guy's weak point! Lorenzini Search!

source_blocks.text: 俺様の速さを刮目して見ろ!

我が輩の喜怒哀楽を引き出せぬなら、お主たちは一生我が輩の下で潰されることになる
悲しみの銀河で溺れるお前を、俺が救ってやれたなら。ハコブーを救えないのは俺の力不足だ!
こんなに頑張ったのに、うーん悔しい、悔しいよ〜!うう〜
おっ、おい、そんなに泣くな。 そんな悲しそうに泣かれたら、 我が輩は、 我が輩は・・・・・・びえーん
source_blocks.translation:
If you cannot draw out the full range of my emotions—my joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure—then you shall remain crushed under my thumb for the rest of your lives.
If only I could have saved you from drowning in that galaxy of sorrow... It is my own lack of strength that kept me from saving Hakoboo!
I tried so hard... Ugh, it's so frustrating—it's just so frustrating! *Sob*...
H-hey, don't cry like that. When you cry so sadly... I... I just... *Waaaaah!*

source_blocks.text: いやぁ、久々に思いっ切り泣いたら、心が軽くなった。 自分でも驚き桃の木石磨きなんつってな!いや~はっはっは
source_blocks.translation: Man, having a good, hearty cry for the first time in ages really lifted a weight off my shoulders. I'm honestly surprised myself—talk about a shocker! ...Or so I say! Hahaha!

source_blocks.text: いやはや、泣きじゃくるお主と幼い頃の王が重なってな。
source_blocks.translation: Well now, seeing you sobbing like that reminded me of the King when he was a child.

source_blocks.text: あの頃のオラディン様は聡明ではあったが、いかんせん幼くあられた故
source_blocks.translation: Lord Oradin was indeed intelligent in those days, but—as was inevitable—he was still quite young.

source_blocks.text: 我が輩は、オラディン王をお育てしたストーンにして、オラディン王に魔進にしていただいた、
source_blocks.translation: I am the Stone that raised King Oradin — the Stone King Oradin turned into a Mashin!

source_blocks.text: クリスタリアーの剛の者ハコブーなり!ブーーーー!
source_blocks.translation: I am Hakoboo, a mighty warrior of Crystalia! Vroooom!

source_blocks.text: 久しぶりだな、みんな。 見よ!私は本当の不死鳥になったぞ
source_blocks.translation: It's been a while, everyone. Behold! I have become a true phoenix.

source_blocks.text: 相変わらず画奮使いが荒いですなはっはっはっはっ!
source_blocks.translation: You're still as rough as ever with your artists—hahahaha!

source_blocks.text: よーし、私も戦っちゃうぞ!
source_blocks.translation: Alright, I'm going to fight too!

source_blocks.text: 完成、グレイトフルフェニックス!

OK牧場、充瑠くん!懲りないガルザにはこってりコテコテのお仕置きだ!
ブー!先日はガルザに拘束されるという我が輩の失態をお許しくださり、まことに恐縮です!
王は本当に幼い頃から、お優しく・・・・・
source_blocks.translation:
You got it, Juru-kun! We're going to give that incorrigible Garza a real, heavy-duty thrashing!
*Snort!* I am truly humbled that you forgave my blunder of letting Garza capture me the other day!
Your Majesty has been so kind ever since you were just a small child...

source_blocks.text: 呼ばれて飛び出てザザザビューン!
source_blocks.translation: You called, so here I come—whoosh!

source_blocks.text: 呼ばれてないが俺様も行く!
source_blocks.translation: I wasn't called, but I'll go too!

source_blocks.text: あのミンジョとかいう奴、あいつはヌマージョの妹なんだ。 俺にやらせてくれっ!
source_blocks.translation: That Minjo or whatever—she's Numajo's little sister. Let me do it!

source_blocks.text: へっ!いい夢見ろよ羊野郎!

Transliteration choices for coined names (魔進ザビューン, 魔進ハコブー, 魔進オラディン, 魔進ファイヤ) are approximate: rendered as Mashin Za Byuun, Mashin Hakoboo, Mashin Oradin, Mashin Fire.
Lines ending with '&' (e.g., ゴーキラメイレッド&) appear truncated or continued; kept as-is with '&'.
The third line "COOめキーングしてみました!" is unclear in the source and may be misread; translation kept the apparent wording as "COO-me keying."
The name "博多南さん" is transcribed as Hakataminami; if this is a different intended reading, the proper name may differ.
The transliteration "ロレンチーニサーチ" is rendered as "Lorenzini Search" based on likely reference to Lorenzini; if another term was intended, meaning could change.
The final Japanese line appears cut off after 'いただいた、' and may be incomplete; English preserves the trailing comma/unfinished phrase.
